column6: eval (() => {   const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table.wikitable tbody tr, table tbody tr'));   for (const row of rows) {     if (row.innerText && row.innerText.includes('Tungsten')) {       return Array.from(row.cells).map(cell => cell.innerText.trim());     }   }   return 'Not found'; })()
